label: Pydantic AI
description: The workflow becomes a Pydantic AI flow: an async function for each block, Pydantic AI Agents (OpenAIChatModel, Tool, NativeOutput for typed answers) for the AI blocks, and a FLOW that AgentCanvas's flow engine runs as the canvas draws it. Any catalog model works, and tool calls can wait for a person's approval (Pydantic AI's deferred tools). Runs need Pydantic AI installed on the server (`make framework FW=pydantic_ai`); designing and exporting do not. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.set: an async function that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: the flow engine follows the first route whose CEL rule matches (generated orchestration: Pydantic AI has no graph of its own)
notes.core.join: the flow engine waits for every branch before the block runs
notes.core.approval: the run pauses and is saved as JSON; it continues from that step when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the run pauses and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.core.llm: a Pydantic AI Agent with the block's model, asked once with agent.run
notes.core.agent: a Pydantic AI Agent (instructions, model, tools, NativeOutput); tools named in 'Ask before using' are Tool(requires_approval=True): the run pauses on DeferredToolRequests and continues from the saved message history with DeferredToolResults
notes.mw.model_call_limit: UsageLimits(request_limit=...) on the agent's run: past the limit the agent stops with a note, or the run fails when the block says so
notes.core.decide: the step asks its model once (an "Ask AI" call) to pick a path and say how sure it is, saves {choice, confidence, reason}, and the flow engine follows the choice (the default path when there is none or it is below the minimum confidence)
